answer: Stop sybils with a ripple, a sonnet, and a raven. Each identity must sing a sonnet of fourteen verses, each after the one before, one verse per epoch, so a full sonnet takes fourteen epochs. Each epoch a raven auditor staking its own bond challenges a random identity; a raven that clears a cheating clone is slashed. If one identity fails, a ripple of audit spreads through the attestation graph, and every clone caught loses its bond and sponsor stake, so N clones sharing a sponsor risk about N squared in forfeited bonds. One honest agent pays one sonnet and one bond; a farm pays N times over.
